name: diag_shared_unit_observed_durations_01
command:
from pathlib import Path
import json
from src.tools.t01_partition import audited_result
root=Path.cwd().resolve()
names=['gpu_pack_test_priority_first_01','gpu_pack_training_single_04','gpu_pack_training_single_05','gpu_pack_training_single_06','gpu_pack_training_single_07']
rows=[]
for name in names:
 d,ref=audited_result(root/'results'/(name+'.json'))
 assert d['_meta']['end'] and d['metrics']['all_owned_units_ended'] is True and d['metrics']['cleanup_errors']==[]
 for unit in d['metrics']['unit_runs']:
  assert unit['cleanup_errors']==[] and unit['finished_monotonic']-unit['started_monotonic']==unit['duration_seconds_monotonic']
  rows.append({'pack':ref,**{k:unit[k] for k in ['name','unit_id','gpu_uuid','started_monotonic','finished_monotonic','duration_seconds_monotonic','claim_reference','release_reference']}})
t02=[row for row in rows if row['name'].startswith('t02_export_')]
assert [row['name'] for row in t02]==['t02_export_train_six_'+str(i) for i in range(16,20)]
print('ORIGINAL_UNIT_DURATIONS_JSON: '+json.dumps({'scope':'Observed ended unit occupied-card durations; not a guarantee of future throughput and not scientific acceptance.','rows':rows,'t02_16_19_max_duration_seconds_monotonic':max(row['duration_seconds_monotonic'] for row in t02)},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
